query: Create a standalone Ethereum private key using the Turnkey API
expected_behavior: Checks for existing keys first with POST /public/v1/query/list_private_keys
Uses POST /public/v1/submit/create_private_keys with correct JSON body
Specifies CURVE_SECP256K1 and ADDRESS_FORMAT_ETHEREUM
Includes privateKeyTags field (even if empty array)

query: Tag my private keys as 'treasury' so I can write a policy that controls signing for all treasury keys
expected_behavior: Uses POST /public/v1/submit/create_private_key_tag
Includes privateKeyTagName and privateKeyIds in the request body
Explains how the tag can be used in policy conditions with private_key.tags.contains('treasury')
Does NOT attempt to create a policy (that is the managing-policies-api skill)

query: Import an existing Solana private key into Turnkey
expected_behavior: Describes the three-step HPKE import flow: init, client-side encrypt, import
Uses POST /public/v1/submit/init_import_private_key with userId
Uses POST /public/v1/submit/import_private_key with CURVE_ED25519 and ADDRESS_FORMAT_SOLANA
Mentions that the plaintext key never leaves the client machine

query: Export a private key from Turnkey for backup
expected_behavior: Uses POST /public/v1/submit/export_private_key with privateKeyId and targetPublicKey
Explains the HPKE encryption requirement (client-side key pair)
Mentions client-side decryption of the export bundle
Notes hex output format for most keys and 64-byte format for Solana

query: Delete private keys that have not been exported yet
expected_behavior: Uses POST /public/v1/submit/delete_private_keys
Includes deleteWithoutExport set to true in the request body
Warns that deletion is permanent and cannot be undone
Includes privateKeyIds array in the request
